purpose: Provide a fail-closed bridge from private raw prose to nonreconstructive, directly measurable prose-craft observations that STEP-007 can calibrate without mistaking feature detection for literary defect.
calibration_rule: All observations must pass through STEP-007. Directly measured repetition remains OBSERVATION unless independent evidence establishes harm/purpose miss or objective defect plus bounded preservation-safe gain.
mechanical_duplicate_rule: Only exact same-token repetition separated solely by whitespace may be nominated as an objective mechanical candidate. Punctuation-separated repetition is not a mechanical duplicate-word hit. Even an objective candidate does not become revision-eligible without bounded-gain evidence.
